description: Set the global 'block_none_refer' policy for the library. When true, playback requests that carry NO referer are blocked; when false, they are allowed. This is the master switch that activates/deactivates domain protection for requests without a referer. On error the API returns { errCode, errMsg }. library_id is resolved automatically when omitted.

block_none_refer.description: true = block playback requests with no referer; false = allow them

library_id.description: Library UUID. Resolved from GET /library when omitted.

name: panda_set_block_none_refer
title: Toggle Block-No-Referer Policy
